messages.subject: predicting from a fitList
parts:
I am fitting n-mixture models in unmarked and would like to make a
prediction from a single model contained within a fitList. Is this
possible? I know that I can make a model averaged prediction from a
fitList, but I was looking for a convenient way to make multiple
predictions from a set of models using the fitList construction.

I am hoping to do something like

mod1=pcount(..... )
mod2=pcount(..... )
mod3=pcount(..... )
Models=fitLst(m1=mod1, m2=mod2, m3=mod3)

Then I would like to do:

predict(Models[1], type='state', newdata)
predict(Models[2], type='state', newdata)
predict(Models[3], type='state', newdata)

or better yet:

for (i in 1:3){ predict(Models[i], type='state', newdata) }

Is this possible using a fitList?

Thanks,

Lew Coggins

messages.author: 057bfe4d4b636b43
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] predicting from a fitList
parts:
I don't know about fitList here, but one solution would be

Model2 = c("mod1","mod2","mod3")

for(i in 1:3) predict(get(Model2[i]), type='state',newdata)

if you want to save the output to a particular names vector

pred.names = paste("pred.mod.",1:3,sep="")
for(i in 1:3) assign(pred.names[i], predict(get(Model2[i]), type='state', newdata))

Matthew
